Matching texture after 1-pixel smoothing

Texture panels use the same fixed blue–white–red scale, with zero at white. Radiance uses one fixed scale for the full sequence. Smoothing is used only for matching; the fitted radiance data are not smoothed. The mask panel describes baseline preprocessing; patch counts also show support after smoothing.

A reference patch with even one missing texture pixel is rejected by the current matcher. All-valid does not guarantee a match: the later-frame search must also contain a valid patch with sufficient correlation. The yellow box is fixed in grid coordinates, not feature tracking. The jump at the loop boundary is a playback reset.
